output.title: Contemporary 3-Bedroom Apartment with Balcony and Parking in Kirchberg
output.description:
This newly built 3-bedroom apartment offers 145 m² of thoughtfully designed living space in Luxembourg's Kirchberg district. Featuring a spacious living room with double-height ceilings and engineered wood flooring, the area benefits from abundant natural light through large south-facing windows, enhancing the open-plan connection to the dining space.

The kitchen is outfitted with high-end Bulthaup cabinetry and a stone worktop, complemented by an induction cooktop and a breakfast bar that serves as a functional focal point. The finishes present a minimalist and modern aesthetic consistent throughout the residence.

A private balcony with glass balustrades and tiled flooring overlooks Kirchberg park, providing a quiet setting suitable for relaxed mornings. The property includes two bathrooms finished with porcelain tiles; the master ensuite is equipped with a walk-in rain shower, a double vanity, and underfloor heating that extends to the entire apartment.

Additional amenities comprise an elevator for convenient access, an assigned parking space, and a cellar offering separate storage in the building. The apartment provides city views characteristic of the Kirchberg area, known for its modern architecture and role as a European business district housing EU institutions and cultural venues such as the Philharmonie and MUDAM.

highlights.text: South-facing living room with double-height ceiling
Bulthaup kitchen with induction cooktop and stone worktop
Elevator access and parking space included
Underfloor heating throughout bathrooms and ensuite
